body: Founder hit 'add Fox --tag emo --tag FFXI' failing with context deadline exceeded and no queued output -- root cause was vertexTextGenerate's 30s HTTP timeout (used to create new forced/hybrid styles), far tighter than vertexGenerateImage's 90s, and running before anything gets queued. Bumped to 90s. Live-verified: same exact command now creates the hybrid style and publishes successfully (fox-emo-ffxi). Commit emily.cli 4536e9e.
title: Fix vertexTextGenerate 30s timeout causing silent style-creation hangs
